proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9917 maśaka gives Bengali maśā, Oriya masā and Maithili mos mosquito. Hajong and Adivasi Oriya mosa match this eastern mosquito family with the source vowels and sibilants retained. Exact survey form mosa is preserved.
